$description: AI Teaching Tool — DARK mode color overrides (Spec 017). Warm dark + the same marigold #FEB70C. Overrides the `color` group of tokens.json; all non-color tokens (fontFamily/weight/size, spacing, radius, typography) are shared and unchanged. W3C DTCG format.

canvas.$description: Page canvas — warm near-black (not cold terminal)

surface.$description: Raised card/panel on the dark canvas

surfaceSubtle.$description: Recessed inset — code blocks, detail panels, input fills

border.$description: Card outline, input border, nav separator

brand.$description: Marigold yellow (#FEB70C) — unchanged from light. FILL behind ink text only; never thin text/icons.

yellow.$description: Primary brand fill — CTA, active pill, highlight, tags (ink text on top)

yellowStrong.$description: Hover / border on yellow elements (brighter on dark)

yellowTint.$description: Faint highlight wash — active-nav background (~16% alpha)

link.$description: Warm gold text link (readable on dark); default links = ink + underline

bg.$description: Primary action — yellow fill (the logo move)

text.$description: Ink text on the yellow button (stays dark)

semantic.$description: Content-only: category tags & code syntax. NEVER on UI chrome. Brightened for dark.
